title: Scout (Phase I audit): requirement-by-requirement matrix of phase-i-program.md P0-P7 against the current source and tests
spec: Objective: implementation-map audit. Read .orchestrator/phase-i-program.md (42 lines) and .orchestrator/roadmap-completion-program.md section P1 (the checklist). For EVERY requirement bullet in Phase I P0-P7 decide the status from the SOURCE (not from memory or docs): implemented_tested | implemented_undertested | partial | missing | experimental_gated. Evidence must be file:line plus the test name(s) in tests/ that cover it (grep 'def test_' in tests/test_scorecard.py, test_attribution.py, test_baseline.py, test_spawn.py, test_executor.py, test_jev_route.py, test_jev_rank.py, test_jev.py, test_daemon.py). Inspect: orchestrator/scorecard.py (efficiency, by_task, by_goal, review_quality, expected_cost, class_success), attribution.py, baseline.py (save/compare/fingerprint), spawn.py (_packet_body, packet_run_meta, review_packet, spec_review_packet, scout_packet, fit_result), executor.py (resume_plan, reply), daemon.py (_fix_round_delta, _dispatch_reply_worker, _open_reviews reviewer_role, _load_review_cfg complementary), jev_route.py (classify, cache, hypothetical, shadow_context, record_shadow), jev_rank.py, jev.py (timeout, malformed, budget, redaction), .orchestrator/prompts/*.md, .orchestrator/pool.toml [jev], [jev.routing], [review], [limits]. Specific questions: (1) P0 metrics: which of tokens/USD per accepted task and goal, tokens and time to first green, time to accepted, first-pass success, fix-round rate, avg fix rounds, fix-round token attribution, calls/turns per accepted task, model distribution, pipeline amplification, grouping by task/goal/executor/model/complexity/task class exist, and which are missing. (2) P1 packets: which roles have deterministic packets, is packet input size measured per role (packet_run_meta), is there a challenge packet and a planner-decision packet, how is stale packet reuse prevented (hash/base sha). (3) P2: all fix-round economics columns present? resume preserved? (4) P3/P4: is active mode implemented or only a notification stub (jev_route.py:167-171 says active ranking lands in P5); which of the 19 routing test cases in the roadmap-completion brief P1 have tests; is there a routing evaluation report comparing baseline vs hypothetical against outcomes (cli routing_eval?). (5) P6: complementary roles and overlap telemetry exist (scorecard.review_quality, daemon reviewer_role) — are reviews spawned concurrently? (6) P7: any Jev decision points (scout necessity, context escalation, review escalation, planner relaunch)? Output format, STRICT, total under 5500 characters: one line per requirement: 'PI.P<n>.<short-key> | <status> | <file:line,...> | <tests or none> | <gap in <=12 words>'. Then a final line 'UNCERTAIN: ...' listing anything you could not verify. No prose, no transcript.
acceptance: Every Phase I P0-P7 requirement bullet appears as one matrix line with status, evidence file:line, tests, gap
Result under 5500 characters, structured lines only
Statuses derived from source and tests, not from memory or docs
